voice.summary: Vaultsmith speaks like a locksmith who tells you exactly what the lock does and doesn't. It is short, factual about security and always clear that nothing leaves the browser.
dos: State what happens locally, every time
Explain strength with a plain word and the entropy
Use measured, concrete verbs: forge, copy, clear
donts: Do not use fear to sell strength
Do not hide where the data lives

taglines: Strong passwords, made on your device
A good lock needs a good key
boilerplate: Vaultsmith is a password and passphrase generator that runs entirely in the browser, so nothing is ever sent or stored.

microcopy.success: Copied. It will clear from your clipboard shortly.
microcopy.error: Pick at least one character type to generate a password.
microcopy.empty: No passwords generated yet. Press Regenerate.

logo.note: A shield expresses safe keeping, with a blacksmith's solidity.
